items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: authored by yourself – Louie Bellson – and Gil Brines

ctx.x: that you’ve brought to the art-form. We’re now talking about your publications. I want to go back to the very beginning. You have here, for the record – it says Bellson Music Company from Moline, Illinois. It’s a picture of you on a drum set, and inside you have some exercises. When I brought out this book yesterday – Modern Reading Texts in 4/4, published by Bellwin Mills, authored by yourself – Louie Bellson – and Gil Brines – is that correct, Brines or Breenes?
Gil Bri-nes [pronounced as a two-syllable surname and with a soft “i”].
Brines. Okay. When I brought this out, you said, “These were exercises I was working with way back when I was either a teen or a youngster.”
